title: arctostaphylos nummularia subsp. sensitiva
intro: Arctostaphylos nummularia subsp. sensitiva, commonly known as sensitive manzanita or sensitive bearberry, is a shrub plant species belonging to the family Ericaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, skin protection, and reducing the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of A. nummularia subsp. sensitiva include modulating the immune system, exhibiting antioxidant activity, and acting as a potential anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, hydroquinone, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its health-promoting effects.
